text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: release v2026.4 -> prod (canary 10% -> 50% over 30m). Config flags: canary-batching-v2=true, shedder-threshold=0.65. Triggered by pipeline #5283 :rocket:

emma (eng-oncall): seeing a sudden 5xx spike from the hosted gateway at ~canary start. Grafana alert firing: gateway_5xx_rate up from 0.3% to ~6% in 5m. Paging support since customers are hitting 502s.

maria (support): multiple customer escalations coming in: account acct-555 reports 502s and failed billing calls. They're seeing "upstream service unavailable" errors in their logs.

noah (eng-sre): adding traces — correlating requests to route /v1/generate. Root cause looks like increased queue time on canary nodes, then upstream timeout 502 from inference runtime.

emma (eng-oncall): logs from gateway (snippet):
```
2026-05-18T15:03:21Z ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_error=timeout downstream=502 latency_ms=12034
2026-05-18T15:03:22Z WARN canary-node-7 kv-cache-miss=true batch_size=12
```

raj (eng): I pushed canary-batching-v2 to enable continuous batching and changed shedder-threshold to 0.65 to trade latency for throughput. Looks like the new batching increases batch assembly time under our latency SLOs for short requests. Canary nodes are accumulating long-tail batches causing gateway timeouts.

emma (eng-oncall): confirmed. Canary nodes show higher p95 token latency and many open connections. Also seeing increased memory spikes.

alice (product): we need to decide rollback vs rapid fix. Customer impact looks non-trivial (billing failures). Recommend rollback of the canary flag to restore baseline.

maria (support): we're routing impacted customers to status@redwood — can we set a temporary mitigation (retry header or fallback model)? Customers want immediate SLA acknowledgement.

noah (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) pause canary traffic ramp (stop at 10%), 2) disable canary-batching-v2 on canary instances, 3) increase shedder-threshold back to 0.85, 4) monitor.

emma (eng-oncall): I'm going to rollback the flag on the canary rollout now. Executing deploy command:
```
# rollback canary flag to previous config
releases update v2026.4 --flag canary-batching-v2=false --flag shedder-threshold=0.85 --env=prod --target=canary
```

deploy-bot: Flag update job queued (job id 45722). Rolling updates to canary nodes.

ops-bot: Notifying runbook channel and creating incident ticket INC-3141.

raj (eng): while we roll back, we should also throttle canary traffic at the load balancer and enable extra shedder logging to capture batch build times. Adding quick patch to canary k8s annotation: `traffic-weight:10` -> `traffic-weight:0` for immediate stop.

emma (eng-oncall): applied `traffic-weight:0` to canary subset. Confirmed via `kubectl get svc traffic` -> canary pods removed from LB.

maria (support): got confirmation from acct-555 — their requests are now succeeding again. They reported success within 4 minutes after rollback.

noah (eng-sre): metrics update: gateway_5xx_rate back down to 0.4% within 6 minutes. p95 latency returned to baseline. Memory pressure on previously affected nodes decreasing.

alice (product): great, please draft a brief incident update for affected customers explaining we rolled back an experimental batching flag and that we're investigating.

emma (eng-oncall): creating incident summary now. Initial root cause hypothesis: canary-batching-v2 increased batch assembly latency for short-tail requests under certain request mixes, causing timeouts at the gateway and failed billing flows where downstream systems are sensitive to 5xx. Next steps: repro, create regression test, add automated canary safety gate for latency spikes >2x baseline, and tighten shedder behavior.

raj (eng): for repro: running traffic replay with short prompt distribution and enabling the batching flag in a sandbox. I'll capture KV cache hit/miss and batch assembly duration and attach traces.

maria (support): raising an official customer incident notice and assigning follow-ups: support will contact top 5 affected customers with root cause once postmortem is ready.

ops-bot: Incident INC-3141 created. Severity S2. Channels: #incidents, #eng-oncall.

emma (eng-oncall): action items captured in INC-3141:
- raj: create reproducible test harness for short-tail prompts + canary-batching-v2 (ETA 24h)
- noah: add alert gating for canary rollouts when gateway_5xx_rate > threshold (ETA 48h)
- raj/emma: add automated traffic stop if p95 latency > 2x during canary ramp (ETA 72h)
- maria: customer comms (ETA 2h)

alice (product): also please add a doc update describing when to gate batching flags behind stricter runtime checks.

maria (support): posting a customer-facing status update now.

emma (eng-oncall): thanks all. After we verify stability for 30m, I'll close the incident and start postmortem draft. :thumbsup:

support-lead: noted — escalate any billing-related ripple effects to billing-eng and cc finance.

emma (eng-oncall): closing notes: canary traffic was halted, flags rolled back, customer impact mitigated. Will keep this thread for postmortem comments.

noah (eng-sre): adding initial logs + graphs to INC-3141. Good catch everyone.

maria (support): thanks team. Customers acknowledged the update and appreciate quick rollback.

emma (eng-oncall): incident closed for now; postmortem will be shared in 48h. :white_check_mark:
